svg.title: Unit 9 claim ladder for the fictional route case
svg.desc: Four vertically ordered evidence steps: the file contains eight of twenty-four desk reports and zero of twelve poster reports; an independent Beta one one model gives a posterior mean route difference of 0.275 and 95 percent interval 0.042 to 0.490; a Beta two two sensitivity interval -0.017 to 0.456 includes zero; neither result identifies an intervention effect or a campus rate. The report recommends design and measurement work before action.
svg.text: Move from records to a bounded report
Fictional convenience volunteers; one seven-day self-report each.
Interval [-0.017, 0.456]; selection and measurement still need an audit.
Define an intervention, validate the outcome and obtain a suitable comparison.
A probability of association under a model cannot supply missing assignment or a campus sampling frame.
